tasks.label: OpenCV: Build and Run
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; cmake -S . -B build-mingw -G 'MinGW Makefiles' '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=D:/c-translation/mingw64/bin/g++.exe' '-DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM=D:/c-translation/mingw64/bin/mingw32-make.exe' '-DOpenCV_DIR=C:/msys64/ucrt64/lib/cmake/opencv5'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build build-mingw --parallel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $env:Path = 'C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin;' + $env:Path; $runFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('opencv_scheme1-' + [guid]::NewGuid() + '.exe'); Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'build-mingw/opencv_scheme1.exe' -Destination $runFile; try { & $runFile input.png output; $runExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $runFile }; exit $runExitCode
